title: Syspop
summary: Syspop synthesizes individual-level (agent-based) population data from aggregated census and survey data such as New Zealand's Integrated Data Infrastructure outputs. An archived experimental script (etc/archive/var_synpop/ctgan_test_sdv.py) imports SDV's MultiTableMetadata and HMASynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic multi-table census data as an alternative synthesis approach.
needs: Usage is confined to an archived/experimental file (etc/archive/var_synpop), unclear if this approach was ever adopted into the main Syspop synthesis pipeline.
